maintenance.changeRule: A structured-data mapping, entity identity rule, approval state, or completion claim may change only with an owner issue, source URL, visible-content evidence, validation plan, rollback path, and #714-linked rationale.

sourcePolicy.sourceUseRule: Use Google Search feature documentation to decide rich-result eligibility, and schema.org semantics to decide whether a type accurately describes visible page content. Schema existence alone is not approval.

publisher.name: DeGov
publisher.sameAsPolicy: Only verified official DeGov-controlled profiles and product URLs may be included. Do not add community mirrors, unverified social profiles, or DAO-specific links to the publisher identity.

daoEntityRule.sameAsPolicy: Use only DAO official URLs verified from approved registry/configuration data and visible on the public DAO page. Do not include user-submitted, unverified, private, or stale links.
daoEntityRule.hostIsolationRule: The DAO @id, url, logo, sameAs links, and JSON-LD entity facts must come from the active validated DAO configuration, never from the request Host header alone or another DAO cache entry.
daoEntityRule.visibleContentRule: DAO name, logo/image when used, description, canonical URL, and official links must be visible on the page or directly cited by visible page content.

entityIdentity.urlAgreementRule: For each approved public page, JSON-LD url/mainEntityOfPage, HTML canonical, og:url, and sitemap URL must agree on the validated production origin and canonical path.
entityIdentity.localeRule: Localized names, descriptions, and inLanguage values may be emitted only when the visible localized page content is available and uses the same canonical/alternate strategy as the route contract.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: The official homepage is the canonical product/publisher surface and already has an Organization/WebSite implementation to recheck against the shared identity contract.
requiredVisibleEvidence: public logo or image when used
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Remove or revert the homepage JSON-LD block if identity, canonical, or visible-content agreement fails.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: Generic WebPage markup can describe visible pricing/content pages without claiming a richer unsupported product or FAQ result.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Fall back to no route-level JSON-LD if pricing facts, visible content, or supported-type requirements are not stable.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: BreadcrumbList is appropriate only when the docs page exposes visible canonical breadcrumbs.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Disable BreadcrumbList for docs pages whose visible breadcrumb or canonical host cannot be proven.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: Docs article markup needs real author, review/update dates, publisher, headline, and article body evidence; build dates must not be used as freshness.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Do not emit Article/TechArticle until editorial authorship and date semantics are approved.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: The Square directory can be a CollectionPage/ItemList only when DAO items and links are present in initial visible HTML.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Remove ItemList markup if directory items are not server-readable or canonical DAO links cannot be verified.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: A public DAO homepage may describe the DAO as an Organization when identity facts are visible and host-isolated.
requiredVisibleEvidence: visible DAO description or governance context
verified official DAO links when sameAs is emitted
visible logo or image when image is emitted
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Disable DAO Organization markup for the affected route if configuration, canonical, sameAs, or cache isolation fails.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: Proposal detail pages may use generic page/creative-work semantics, but must not be misclassified as Article, Legislation, NewsArticle, or DiscussionForumPosting by default.
requiredVisibleEvidence: visible data-as-of or source freshness when emitted
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Fall back to no proposal JSON-LD if proposal visibility, source, or entity alignment cannot be proven.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: Atlas DAO detail pages can describe the visible DAO entity and breadcrumb context when the canonical Atlas route and DAO identity are stable.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Remove Atlas DAO JSON-LD if the visible DAO entity, breadcrumb, or canonical route cannot be proven.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: ProfilePage requires an approved public participant/profile indexing policy and privacy review before describing people or organizations.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Do not emit ProfilePage until profile privacy, public value, and index policy are approved.

pageClassDecisions.rationale: Dataset markup requires a real dataset landing page and explicit license, creator, distribution/access, and provenance contract.
pageClassDecisions.rollback: Do not emit Dataset until Atlas has an approved dataset product contract.

explicitRejections.reason: A governance proposal page is not automatically editorial journalism, a forum thread, or legislation. Use only a generic page/creative-work mapping unless visible content and product semantics justify a narrower type.
FAQ markup is not a growth KPI and must not be added unless the FAQ content is visible and appropriate; Google FAQ rich results are restricted and should not drive bulk FAQ expansion.
Ratings, reviews, authors, and freshness dates must not be invented or derived from build/deploy time.
Participant or profile markup is blocked until privacy, public value, and indexability policies are approved.

validationModel.rollbackProcedure: Remove or disable the affected JSON-LD block, preserve canonical/meta behavior, record the failure class and affected route, and link the rollback evidence to the owner issue and #714.

repositoryFollowUps.scope: Recheck existing Organization/WebSite JSON-LD after home PR #31, align @id with the shared publisher identity, and add only visible-content-backed WebPage markup for approved content pages.
Add visible-breadcrumb-backed BreadcrumbList markup; defer Article/TechArticle until authorship and real date semantics exist.
Add CollectionPage/ItemList only when DAO directory items and canonical links are present in initial visible HTML.
Add host-isolated DAO Organization markup and optional generic proposal page/CreativeWork markup with invalid/private route exclusion.
Add Atlas DAO Organization/BreadcrumbList markup; defer ProfilePage and Dataset until privacy and dataset contracts are approved.

completionState.closeIssueWhen: The shared entity contract is approved, repository-specific implementation issues are linked for approved mappings, official-site JSON-LD is rechecked after degov-home PR #31, validator/readback evidence exists for implemented mappings, and #714 has the final evidence summary.
